edges.reason: initialize writes LIMIT_TOKENS.
initialize writes tokenPrice.
initialize writes baseURI.
initialize writes saleIsActive.
setBaseURI assigns _newBaseURI into baseURI.
setTokenPrice assigns _newPrice into tokenPrice.
setLimitToken assigns _newLimitToken into LIMIT_TOKENS.
toggleSaleState flips the saleIsActive flag.
mintNFT requires saleIsActive to be true before minting.
mintNFT checks totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) <= MAX_TOKENS using SafeMath addition.
mintNFT checks totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) <= LIMIT_TOKENS using SafeMath addition.
mintNFT requires msg.value >= tokenPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) using SafeMath multiplication.
mintNFT calls _safeMint, which triggers an external receiver callback while state is still being updated.
_safeMint calls _mint to record ownership.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which performs an external call.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_checkOnERC721Received calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract, giving it control flow.
withdraw performs a low-level call forwarding the whole balance to owner().
_authorizeUpgrade is implemented with onlyOwner which reads the _owner state variable.
upgradeTo calls _authorizeUpgrade before changing the implementation.
upgradeToAndCall calls _authorizeUpgrade before changing the implementation.
_functionDelegateCall delegates execution to an owner-supplied implementation address.
msg.sender is passed as the to parameter of _safeMint.
msg.sender determines the recipient of the safe mint call.
numberOfTokens parameter controls the mint loop quantity.
local id is computed from totalSupply() inside mintNFT.
computed id is passed into _safeMint.
loop counter i controls iterations of the mint loop.
_newBaseURI parameter is stored through setBaseURI.
_newPrice parameter is stored through setTokenPrice.
_newLimitToken parameter is stored through setLimitToken.
newImplementation parameter is supplied to the upgrade authorization hook.
to parameter is used as the mint recipient in _safeMint.
tokenId parameter is used as the minted id in _safeMint.
tokenId parameter is used to build the metadata URI.
currentBaseURI local is concatenated in tokenURI.
_owner parameter selects tokens to enumerate.
tokenCount local sizes the returned array.
newImplementation parameter is passed to upgradeTo.
newImplementation parameter is passed to upgradeToAndCall.
data parameter is delegated after the upgrade.
from parameter identifies the previous owner in _transfer.
to parameter identifies the new owner in _transfer.
tokenId parameter identifies the token being transferred.
the to address determines the target of the external onERC721Received call.
target parameter is the destination of the delegatecall.
